userMessages.text: The gateway now separates interactive and batch traffic during admission and scheduling. When capacity is constrained, interactive work preempts batch work, while displaced batch requests are parked with their state preserved and resumed when capacity returns instead of failing. Tenant spend ceilings and quota accounting still apply to combined usage across both classes.

params.description:
# LLM inference gateway

A capability-tier request flows through identity stamping and combined tenant quota/spend admission, then splits into interactive and batch scheduling lanes. Interactive work receives priority when capacity is constrained; displaced batch work is parked with state preserved and resumes when capacity returns rather than failing. Both classes rejoin deadline-aware queuing, cache, prompt policy, and tier-aware routing into hosted or self-hosted capacity. Attempts classify pre-token failures and retry safely before streaming; circuit breakers and spend controls protect capacity, while metering feeds billing and redacted audit storage. Dashed pink evaluation traffic remains isolated from the client response.
